items.title: You shouldn’t just be learning astrology
items.summary:
You shouldn’t just be learning astrology. It’s time to express yourself, share your story, create something from it. That’s why I’ve created the New Wave Astrology Conference⚡️

The first in-person astrology event where you’re not just sitting in lectures, you’re building actual community. 

You’re creating AND collaborating. 

this New Wave of astrology bridges the gap between the technical craft of astrology, and also making it mainstream and alive!

The idea for this all started from seeing a gap in the market. 

There isn’t an astrology conference like the energy and passion of The New Wave. 

Where creative collaboration, innovation and REAL community is formed. 

It’s missing in this industry. 

So it’s time to create it. 

Astrologers are making the craft bigger. More understood. More widely accessible. 

In a language that ACTUALLY MAKES SENSE. 

And not just making it educational, but making it inspiring. 

And that *energy*, clarity and intention is what is going to ripple out into the world and make astrology more respected and mainstream. 

Astrology is going to get bigger. 

It’s going to infiltrate the finance world, the business world, the health and wellness spaces, the travel industry. 

But to help get it bigger, people need to come together instead of competing. 

The mission of the movement is community, not competition.

This is the new world of astrology. 

And you’re invited!!
